Lowest rated

Dire Straits · On Every Street · 4.6/10

The Dire Strait’s final effort wasn’t exactly a “going out with a bang”…rather it feels like a sputtering car running out of gas in the middle of the interstate. “The Bug” is a tight little jig with some old school Knopfler touch, but the remainder of the record feels stale and, frankly, boring. Maybe that tastelessness is worse than a pure stinkfest for a band who were at the highest of highs in the 70s and 80s. We will always have “Sultans” at least!

Read the review

Archive pick

Neck Deep · Neck Deep · 8.2/10

Finally dedicating an eponymous name to a release, Neck Deep come out scorching with this release. Extremely fun effort with lighting fast and barbed wire-tight percussion, Neck Deep served as a strong comeback from a weaker release “All Distortions Are Intentional” which felt frustratingly polished for a pop punk record. “Heartbreak of the Century” is a witty, fast-pasted leading single. The 1/2 hour length makes for a perfect punk record experience. A band in full force, Neck Deep ingrain themselves deeper, rightfully, in the scene.
